categories.main_business_segments: Tongwei Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two main business segments: agriculture (including aquatic feed, livestock feed, aquaculture, breeding, and food processing) and photovoltaic new energy (including high-purity polysilicon, solar cells, photovoltaic modules, and solar power generation). The company integrates upstream to downstream in the photovoltaic industry chain and also develops the 'fishery-photovoltaic integration' model combining ecological aquaculture with green energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced photovoltaic technologies such as N-type TOPCon cells, HJT cells, and back-contact cells, with proprietary PECVD polysilicon deposition technology. It also focuses on intelligent manufacturing and digital upgrades in feed production, including IoT and smart factory platforms. In aquaculture, it uses innovative water treatment and digital management systems to enhance productivity and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tongwei serves global top photovoltaic module manufacturers, domestic central and state-owned enterprises, and overseas markets including Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, and Africa. In agriculture, its primary customers are aquaculture and livestock farmers in China and Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, Bangladesh, and Indonesia. The company also targets large-scale industrial feed customers and end consumers through its food processing and branded aquatic products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production bases in Sichuan, Inner Mongolia, Yunnan, Anhui, and other provinces. It has significant overseas presence in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Bangladesh, Indonesia), Europe, Middle East, and Africa. It also has subsidiaries and sales offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Germany, supporting global market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tongwei operates across the photovoltaic supply chain from upstream high-purity polysilicon production, midstream solar cell manufacturing, to downstream module assembly and solar power plant operation. In agriculture, it covers feed production, breeding, aquaculture, and food processing, representing a vertically integrated supply chain from raw materials to end products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in photovoltaic cells and modules, focusing on multi-technology parallel development including TOPCon, HJT, back-contact, and perovskite/silicon tandem cells. It invests heavily in R&D with over 5,200 personnel and a global innovation center. In agriculture, it emphasizes quality-driven feed development, smart manufacturing, and sustainable aquaculture technologies. The 'fishery-photovoltaic integration' model is a key strategic innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Tongwei generates revenue primarily through product sales of aquatic and livestock feed, high-purity polysilicon, solar cells, photovoltaic modules, and electricity sales from solar power plants. It also earns income from food processing and trading, and provides related technical and financial services. The company engages in long-term sales contracts and spot market sales, with some government subsidies and investment income contributing to revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tongwei is a global leader in photovoltaic polysilicon production and solar cell manufacturing, ranking first worldwide in polysilicon output and solar cell shipments for eight consecutive years. It is among the top five photovoltaic module suppliers globally. In aquaculture feed, it is a leading global producer with strong market share in China and Southeast Asia. The company maintains a competitive edge through scale, technology, and integrated supply chain advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tongwei reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 92 billion, a decline of about 34% year-over-year due to significant price drops in photovoltaic products. The company experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 7 billion, impacted by asset impairments and market pressures. Despite this, it maintains substantial total assets near RMB 196 billion and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D, with a strong cash flow position and ongoing share repurchases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tongwei emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced photovoltaic products with industry-leading conversion efficiencies and cost advantages. Its integrated supply chain from polysilicon to modules ensures quality control and cost competitiveness. In agriculture, it offers differentiated, high-performance feed products supported by strong R&D and smart manufacturing. The unique 'fishery-photovoltaic integration' model creates synergistic value by combining green energy with sustainable aquaculture, enhancing resource utilization and environmental benefits.
